events.title: Rain that never falls
events.body: Condensation beads on the observation blister and slides down in slow lines. You watch until your shift alarm pulls you back. Someone wrote on the glass with a finger: still here.

events.title: A seed in your pocket
events.body: You found it on the floor after tray change — one dark seed, warm from the grow mat. Protocol says incinerate strays. Your palm remembers soil that no longer exists.

options.label: Drop it in the burn bin
Plant it in an empty slot

events.title: The third meal
events.body: Mess hall serves the same protein three ways. Today it tastes like the memory of rain. The person beside you cries quietly into their bowl and pretends it is steam.

events.title: Night watch hum
events.body: The reactor sings at a frequency you feel in your teeth. Tomas says it always did. You count bolts on the access panel until the numbers lose meaning.

events.title: Drawing on the bulkhead
events.body: A child from the youth deck taped a crayon sun to the corridor wall. Security will remove it by evening. For now it casts no light, but people walk slower past it.

options.label: Copy the sun into your notebook

events.title: The salt disappears again
events.body: Mess ran out of salt mid-shift. Raj swears the stores count is correct. Three crew have suspiciously well-seasoned lunches.

events.title: PA plays the wrong century
events.body: The corridor PA booted a classical playlist from Earth archives. Half the deck thinks it is an emergency code. The other half starts waltzing.

events.title: Gym trophy made of scrap
events.body: Someone welded a 'corridor sprint champion' cup from pipe shavings. Kato claims it is official. Sam claims it is a safety violation.

options.label: Vote to display it in mess

events.title: Snoring decibel chart
events.body: Raj posted an anonymous snoring leaderboard near the bunks. You appear twice under different nicknames.

events.title: The mythical vending machine
events.body: New T1s swear a machine on deck 4 dispenses real chocolate. You have walked deck 4 twice. There is only a broken coolant sign.

events.title: Mirror lag
events.body: The washroom mirror shows you a half-second late. Only when you are alone. Only when the vent fan stutters.

events.title: Tea that tastes like grass
events.body: Hana offers you a cup from a new batch. It is sweet. Too sweet. She watches your face the way people watch airlocks.

events.title: Footsteps in sync
events.body: Walking the lab corridor, your steps echo once — then twice — then in perfect unison with something you cannot see.

events.title: Extra face in the photo
events.body: Crew photo from last month. Someone points at the back row. There is a blurred face where the bulkhead should be empty.

events.title: Route vote already decided?
events.body: Mei whispers that the captain signed a cold-route memo before the vote opened. You were not supposed to hear.

options.label: Ask Maya if it is true

events.title: Promotion for favors
events.body: Raj claims a T2 slot went to someone who covered a chief's night shift three times. No names — everyone knows anyway.

events.title: Captain's med visit
events.body: Hana scheduled a private med block for the captain. The slot is usually for quarantine cases.

events.title: Void cult as a joke
events.body: Someone tagged a corridor with 'THE GARDEN WAITS' in grease pencil. Half the deck treats it as memes. Half go quiet.

events.title: Chen's old screwdriver
events.body: Chen hands you a worn driver from before launch. 'Do not lose it. It outranked me once.'

events.title: Sela's seed index
events.body: Sela lets you copy three lines from the vault index — varieties Earth will never see again.

events.title: Dmitri's wrong equation
events.body: Dmitri shows you a derivation with a deliberate error. 'See if Elena catches it before I fix it.'

events.title: Hana stitches your sleeve
events.body: Your uniform tore on a crate edge. Hana sews it during mess prep without being asked.

options.label: Thank and leave a ration bar

events.title: One tray, wrong light
events.body: Pink instead of white. The leaves do not complain.

events.title: Loose bolt, tight schedule
events.body: One turn left. Or one turn too many.

events.title: Letter draft — never sent
events.body: Dear whoever still listens on Earth: the sky here is a wall. I wrote that line three times. The comm officer says no channel remains.

events.title: Note from your bunk neighbor
events.body: Slipped under your door: 'If you take my shift Friday, I owe you two. —O.' You did not agree yet.

events.title: Formal reprimand draft
events.body: Sam shows you a reprimand template with your name filled in. 'Sign or we talk first.'

events.title: Dream: garden in orbit
events.body: You walk barefoot on soil that floats. Roots hang upward like chandeliers. You wake with soil smell that is not on the ship.

events.title: Dream: captain without face
events.body: The captain addresses crew. Where the face should be, grow-light pink. No one else seems to notice.

options.label: Stare at real captain next briefing

events.title: Dream: water runs upward
events.body: Coolant lines flow toward the ceiling. Tomas says in the dream, 'That is how it wants to go.'

events.title: Pre-shift checklist anomaly
events.body: □ Gloves □ Torque □ Buddy sign-off — item 3 unsigned but the panel shows green. Your name is on the sign-off.

events.title: Hydro sanity check
events.body: pH 6.2 ✓  EC 1.8 ✓  Temp 22 ✓  Visual: one tray 'looks wrong' — not on the checklist.

events.title: Ship bulletin: ration change
events.body: WEEKLY BULLETIN — Protein mix ratio shifts 2% toward algae. You read it before your dept chief does.

events.title: Ship bulletin: route poll opens
events.body: WEEKLY BULLETIN — Route preference poll opens Day 12. Your vote weight is printed in small type at the bottom.

events.title: Informal stay interview
events.body: HR pulls you aside after a minor incident. 'Are you still happy on this ship?' Not on any form. On a recorder.

events.title: Skills audit pop quiz
events.body: Yuki asks three questions not in the training packet. 'Elena wants to know who reads beyond the packet.'

events.title: Rust poem on a lathe
events.body: Kato scratched haiku into oil film: 'spin / spin / still not round'. Sam will buff it off by noon.

events.title: Words in condensation
events.body: On the cold store door, someone wrote 'we are still wet' before the frost took it.

events.title: Pull-up bet
events.body: Alex bets you three ration bars you cannot match his pull-up count. Your arms already hurt from shift.

events.title: Zero-G yoga rumor
events.body: Observatory crew claims yoga in the bubble helps nausea. You have never been in the bubble.

events.title: Moss glow after lights-out
events.body: Tray moss faintly luminesces when the spectrum drops. Nadia says some strains do. Jin has not seen it.

events.title: Humming in B-flat
events.body: You hum while working. A vent answers in the same key, half a beat behind.

events.title: Hull harmonic you can't unhear
events.body: After a triple-lathe shift the deck plates buzz in B-flat. You press your palm to the bulkhead and feel it longer than you meant to.

events.title: Numbers that don't sleep
events.body: You open Lee's exchange summary on a personal pad. Two food lines disagree by a crate. Nobody else is awake in the galley.

options.label: Close the pad — not your shift

events.title: Dim rows in Bay A
events.body: Grow lights stutter at sixty percent. The grain trays look fine until you notice the leaves leaning toward the one bright corner.

events.title: After the recycler hiss
events.body: The water loop went offline for an hour. You still hear the hiss when the corridor is quiet — phantom pressure in the pipes.

options.label: Write it in the shift log

events.title: Weighted roll on your chest
events.body: The council posted A/B routes again. You rehearse your lean in the mirror — as if the mirror gets a vote.

events.title: Star chart on your bunk
events.body: Someone taped a hand-drawn node map above your pillow — five dots, six lines. It matches the nav room display a little too well.

events.title: The promise you made
events.body: You told the mess hall rations would hold through the segment. The ledger says otherwise — two days short if nothing changes.

events.title: Observatory shift swap
events.body: Dome duty overlaps the next route briefing. You can watch stars or watch council lean bars — not both.

events.title: Trade you shouldn't have seen
events.body: You witnessed a disputed listing clear exchange without a second signature. Lee hasn't posted the memo yet — you could speak up or vanish.

events.title: Publish button anxiety
events.body: Validation finished on a project you proposed. One roll decides if weeks of power draw matter — or vanish in a fail log.

events.title: Crew panel overload
events.body: You open the crew roster and realize you cannot remember half the names on B-shift. The graph of relations feels like a map of debts.

events.title: Legacy note doubt
events.body: The generation panel asks who inherits your mistakes. You wonder if the legacy field is for heirs — or for the ship's log.

events.title: Pulse in the crawlway
events.body: You feel a silent pulse from the cargo crawlway — not sound, not light. The generation panel lists infection counters you were not meant to see.

options.label: Log it in your private notes

events.title: Audit guilt
events.body: You deferred an audit to keep morale. Now every ration coupon feels like it might be the one that breaks the ledger.

options.label: Bury the feeling — ship needs calm
